blogPosts.title: How Much Does a Bathroom Renovation Cost in Deepdene in 2026?
blogPosts.excerpt: Discover realistic bathroom renovation costs for Deepdene homeowners, from simple updates to luxury overhauls, with expert pricing guidance from the eastern suburbs team.
body: If you are a Deepdene homeowner considering a bathroom renovation, understanding the realistic costs involved is the essential first step. Deepdene's housing stock ranges from charming period terraces to contemporary townhouses, and the scope of your renovation will depend heavily on your home's existing layout, plumbing configuration, and the level of finish you desire. At Simply Bathroom Solutions, we have completed hundreds of bathroom renovations across Deepdene and Melbourne's eastern suburbs, giving us deep insight into what drives costs and how to deliver exceptional value at every budget level.

For a straightforward bathroom renovation in Deepdene — think new tiles, updated fixtures, a fresh vanity, and modern tapware — you can expect to invest between $18,000 and $30,000. This typically covers demolition of existing fittings, waterproofing, tiling, plumbing adjustments, and installation of new fixtures. Deepdene homes, particularly those built in the early-to-mid twentieth century, often require additional work such as addressing outdated plumbing, levelling uneven floors, or dealing with asbestos in older wet areas, which can add to the baseline cost.

A mid-range bathroom renovation in Deepdene, incorporating a custom vanity, frameless shower screen, heated towel rail, underfloor heating, and premium tiles, generally falls between $30,000 and $50,000. This tier often includes design services, which is where our team at Simply Bathroom Solutions truly adds value. Our designers work with you to optimise the layout, select materials that suit the character of your Deepdene home, and ensure every element — from grout colour to cabinet hardware — is cohesively planned before any work begins on site.

For homeowners seeking a luxury bathroom transformation in Deepdene, budgets typically start at $50,000 and can exceed $80,000 for a truly bespoke space. This level includes premium stone surfaces, custom-designed cabinetry, high-end fixtures from brands like Caroma or Meir, walk-in rain showers, freestanding baths, and sophisticated lighting schemes. Heritage homes in Deepdene may also involve structural modifications such as relocating plumbing or expanding the bathroom footprint, which requires careful planning and council considerations.

Several key factors influence the final cost of your Deepdene bathroom renovation. The age and condition of your home's plumbing and structural elements play a significant role, as does the complexity of your desired layout. Moving a toilet or shower to a new position requires more extensive plumbing work than a like-for-like replacement. Material selections — from tile grade to tapware brand — also affect the budget considerably. Our team provides transparent, itemised quotes so Deepdene clients understand exactly where every dollar is allocated.

The best time to plan a bathroom renovation in Deepdene is well before you want the work to begin. At Simply Bathroom Solutions, we recommend allowing two to three months for the design and planning phase, followed by six to ten weeks for construction depending on the scope. Melbourne's eastern suburbs experience peak renovation demand from September through November, so booking your design consultation early ensures your project is scheduled at a time that suits you. Contact our Deepdene team for a free, no-obligation assessment of your bathroom renovation needs.

blogPosts.title: Kitchen Renovation Planning: A Complete Guide for Deepdene Homeowners
blogPosts.excerpt: Everything Deepdene homeowners need to know about planning a kitchen renovation, from layout design to material selection and realistic project timelines.
body: The kitchen is the heart of every Deepdene family home, and a thoughtfully planned renovation can dramatically improve both your daily living and your property's value. Deepdene's proximity to Melbourne's eastern suburbs dining and shopping precincts means local homeowners appreciate quality design and craftsmanship, and a well-executed kitchen renovation reflects that standard. Simply Bathroom Solutions has designed and built kitchens across Deepdene, Malvern, Kew, and Camberwell for nearly two decades, and we understand the unique considerations that come with renovating kitchens in this established, character-rich suburb.

The first step in any Deepdene kitchen renovation is understanding your space and how your family actually uses it. Many homes in Deepdene feature galley-style or L-shaped kitchens that, while functional, often lack the open, connected feel modern families desire. Our design team begins every project with a thorough consultation to assess your current layout, identify structural possibilities such as removing non-load-bearing walls or adding an island bench, and develop a design that maximises both workflow and family interaction. This planning stage is critical and typically takes four to six weeks.

Material selection is where a Deepdene kitchen renovation truly comes to life. Stone benchtops remain the most popular choice among our eastern suburbs clients, with engineered quartz offering durability and low maintenance while natural marble provides timeless elegance. Cabinetry in Deepdene homes often favours classic profiles — shaker doors in two-pack polyurethane or timber veneer — though we are seeing growing demand for sleek, handleless designs in newer townhouses. Splashback options range from traditional subway tiles to dramatic full-height stone or pressed metal panels that complement period features.

Budgeting for a Deepdene kitchen renovation requires careful consideration of several cost drivers. Cabinetry typically represents the largest portion of the budget, accounting for thirty to forty percent of total costs, followed by benchtops, appliances, and labour. A quality kitchen renovation in Deepdene generally starts from $25,000 for a refresh of existing cabinetry and benchtops, while a full redesign including new layout, custom cabinetry, stone surfaces, and premium appliances typically ranges from $45,000 to $75,000 or more. Our transparent quoting process ensures Deepdene clients understand every cost component before committing.

Deepdene's older homes present unique renovation challenges that experienced builders know how to navigate. Outdated wiring may need upgrading to handle modern appliance loads, and gas plumbing may require relining or relocation. Many period homes also have uneven floors or non-standard wall cavities that affect cabinet installation. Simply Bathroom Solutions has extensive experience managing these complexities across Melbourne's eastern suburbs, and our project managers coordinate specialist trades to address each issue efficiently without disrupting the renovation timeline.

Timing your Deepdene kitchen renovation to minimise disruption to family life is important. Most full kitchen renovations take six to eight weeks from demolition to completion, during which you will need an alternative cooking arrangement. We recommend Deepdene homeowners plan their renovation during milder months when outdoor cooking is more practical, and to book their design consultation at least three months in advance. Reach out to our Deepdene office to start planning your dream kitchen with a free, personalised consultation.

blogPosts.title: Signs Your Deepdene Home Needs a Full Renovation
blogPosts.excerpt: Learn the key indicators that your Deepdene property may benefit from a comprehensive whole-home renovation rather than piecemeal updates.
body: Many Deepdene homeowners reach a point where individual room updates no longer address the bigger picture. You may have renovated the bathroom a decade ago and updated the kitchen more recently, but the overall flow, functionality, and feel of your home still does not match your lifestyle. Recognising when a full home renovation is the smarter investment is crucial for Deepdene property owners, as a cohesive, well-planned transformation delivers far greater value — both liveability and resale — than scattered, disconnected improvements.

One of the most common signs that Deepdene homes need a full renovation is when the floor plan no longer serves modern family living. Many properties in the suburb were built in eras when formal living and dining rooms were separate, kitchens were closed off, and laundry spaces were an afterthought. If your family spends most of its time crammed into one living area while other rooms sit underused, a full renovation that opens the floor plan, connects indoor and outdoor spaces, and reconfigures rooms for how you actually live can be genuinely life-changing.

Structural and systemic issues throughout a Deepdene property are another strong indicator that piecemeal repairs are no longer cost-effective. When you are dealing with outdated electrical wiring in the kitchen, deteriorating plumbing in the bathroom, cracked rendering on the exterior, and aging window frames all at the same time, addressing each issue individually becomes both expensive and disruptive. A comprehensive renovation allows Simply Bathroom Solutions to address all building fabric issues simultaneously, often at a lower total cost than sequential repairs.

For Deepdene homeowners considering selling within the next five to ten years, a full renovation can deliver significant returns. The eastern suburbs market in Melbourne places a premium on turnkey properties that require no immediate work, and Deepdene homes that have been thoughtfully renovated throughout command stronger prices. However, the renovation must be cohesive and of consistent quality across all rooms — a beautifully renovated kitchen paired with an outdated bathroom sends mixed signals to buyers and undermines the investment.

Deepdene's heritage and period homes require special consideration when planning a full renovation. Properties with original Victorian, Edwardian, or interwar features demand a design approach that respects architectural character while introducing contemporary comforts. Simply Bathroom Solutions has extensive experience navigating heritage overlay requirements across Melbourne's eastern suburbs, working closely with councils to ensure renovations enhance rather than compromise a home's period charm. Our design team understands how to blend original features like ornate cornices, timber fretwork, and fireplaces with modern kitchen and bathroom amenities.

If you have been considering whether a full renovation makes sense for your Deepdene property, the best step is a comprehensive assessment from an experienced renovation team. Simply Bathroom Solutions offers free, in-depth consultations where we evaluate your home's structural condition, discuss your lifestyle needs and aspirations, and provide honest advice on whether a full renovation or targeted updates represent the best path forward. Contact our Deepdene team to arrange your assessment and take the first step towards your home's transformation.

blogPosts.title: Laundry Renovation Ideas for Melbourne's Eastern Suburbs Homes
blogPosts.excerpt: Practical laundry renovation inspiration for Deepdene and eastern suburbs homeowners looking to maximise space, storage, and style in their laundry.
body: The laundry is one of the most frequently used rooms in any Deepdene home, yet it is often the most neglected in terms of design and functionality. Many homes across Melbourne's eastern suburbs were built with tiny, utilitarian laundries that were designed for a different era of laundry appliances and household routines. A thoughtful laundry renovation can transform this hardworking space into an organised, efficient room that genuinely makes daily life easier. Simply Bathroom Solutions has completed laundry renovations throughout Deepdene, Malvern, Kew, and surrounding suburbs, and we understand how to unlock potential in even the smallest spaces.

Space planning is the foundation of every successful laundry renovation in Deepdene. Many period homes have laundries squeezed into narrow corridors, awkward alcoves, or repurposed cupboards that were never designed for modern front-loading machines and dryers. Our design team specialises in creative layouts that maximise every available centimetre. In some Deepdene homes, this means relocating the laundry to a more practical position — such as under the stairs, into a butler's pantry configuration, or reconfiguring an adjacent linen closet to create a dedicated laundry zone.

Storage solutions make or break a laundry renovation, and this is an area where professional design pays dividends. Deepdene homeowners typically need space for detergents and cleaning supplies, ironing equipment, linen storage, and potentially a drying area. Floor-to-ceiling cabinetry, overhead cupboards, pull-out hampers, and custom shelving systems can transform a cluttered laundry into a streamlined space. We recommend soft-close drawers for everyday items and closed cabinetry to keep the room looking tidy, particularly important in Deepdene homes where the laundry may be visible from living areas.

Benchtop space is a luxury many Deepdene laundries currently lack, but it makes an enormous difference to the room's functionality. A continuous benchtop over front-loading machines provides a folding surface and a place to sort laundry, while an integrated sink with a deep, practical basin adds genuine utility. Material choices for laundry benchtops should prioritise durability and moisture resistance — engineered stone and solid surface materials are excellent choices for Deepdene laundries, and they can be selected to complement kitchen finishes if the two rooms are adjacent.

Ventilation and lighting are critical considerations in Deepdene laundry renovations that are often overlooked. Proper ventilation prevents mould and mildew — a real concern in Melbourne's cooler months when laundry drying indoors is inevitable. We recommend installing quality exhaust fans and, where possible, incorporating a window or skylight for natural light and airflow. LED strip lighting under overhead cabinets and task lighting above the benchtop transform the laundry from a dark, gloomy space into a bright, pleasant room that you do not mind spending time in.

A laundry renovation in Deepdene typically takes two to four weeks depending on the scope, and costs generally range from $12,000 to $30,000 for a comprehensive transformation. This covers demolition, plumbing adjustments, cabinetry, benchtops, tiling, and electrical work. At Simply Bathroom Solutions, we often integrate laundry renovations into broader bathroom or kitchen projects for Deepdene clients, which can deliver cost savings through combined trade coordination. Contact our Deepdene team to discuss your laundry renovation and discover how much more functional your home can become.
